observations.kind: Generated type drift at first Convex dev startup
observations.detail: CLI added an unrelated declarationsFastPass module import to convex/_generated/api.d.ts. Restored exact candidate artifact and restarted with --codegen disable before acceptance/types. No product fix.
One login invocation omitted QA_CHECKOUT and failed import before browser/auth actions; corrected explicit absolute candidate path.
Initial guessed component path matched no files. Correct source path lint passed; root and Convex types each ran once.

Guarded local run() already parses CLI JSON; duplicate JSON.parse failed after authorized read. Corrected QA wrapper, then immediate retry hit ordinary 24-second OTP rate limit. Waited through independent checks; final five access groups passed. Pre-scan null not claimed as final passing group.

Initial full app replay passed13groups then existing five-attempt stage failed before Rescan/long text. Second passed5groups then failed staging legacy. Bounded three-attempt structural diagnostic observed claim:false/status failed twice, then claim:true and actual saved summary verified. Preserved both partial receipts; changed setup-only bound to20 with unchanged guards/claim/finish/verification. Final full15groups and follow-up completed.
Local /ingest/array public project identifier appears in captured HTTP path; public receipt normalizes that identifier. No auth frames, payloads, headers or query values retained.
